% A negative space above a chapter from titlesec's \titlespacing, under a
% \titleformat of the chapter: a chapter, an unnumbered chapter, a part
% with no spacing of its own, an appendix chapter, the bibliography, and
% the index, each after text, none drawn over the text above it, also on
% a phone and in print, and each in view when a link leads to it. The
% first chapter starts the page.
\documentclass{book}
\usepackage{titlesec,makeidx}
\makeindex
\titleformat{\chapter}[display]{\normalfont\huge\bfseries}
    {\chaptertitlename\ \thechapter}{20pt}{\Huge}
\titlespacing{\chapter}{0pt}{-20pt}{20pt}
\begin{document}
\input{test-chapneg-cases.ltx}
